variants.title: Resistance with a universal LCR bridge
variants.aim: Set a universal bridge to its R function, balance it with the main dial on three ranges, and read the resistance of an unmarked resistor.

source.title: University of Delhi B.Sc. (Hons.) Physics practical lists (LOCF 2019 / UGCF 2022)

variants.title: Capacitance with a universal LCR bridge
variants.aim: Set a universal bridge to its C function, balance it with the main dial and the loss dial on three ranges, and read the capacitance of an unmarked capacitor.

source.title: University of Delhi B.Sc. (Hons.) Physics practical lists (LOCF 2019 / UGCF 2022)
